as_told.title: Reagan at the United Nations on an alien threat

plain: President Ronald Reagan is said to have spoken of how quickly the world's differences would vanish if humanity faced "an alien threat from outside this world." Michels shows that line in a clip and places it at the United Nations in 1987, while Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for unusual patents, paraphrases it as a warning that a divided Earth will not withstand what is coming. Michels also says, in another episode, that many of Reagan's mid-1980s speeches dealt with non-human intelligence, which some take as a hint that leaders knew more.
